_meta.rule: A crash counts for a block group if it is inside it or within 10 m of its boundary; crashes on boundary streets count for each bordering block group.
_meta.notes: One layer per year. Pedestrian/bicycle is taken from TypeOfFirstCrash (the first harmful event), so crashes where a pedestrian or cyclist was struck later in the sequence are not counted as pedestrian/bicycle. 'Serious' = AInjuries (KABCO A, incapacitating).
_meta.counting_note: crashes = records the source returned for the county's bounding box (neighbouring counties included); with_coordinates = those with a location inside the box; matched = counted for at least one of this county's block groups; on_boundary = matched crashes counted for more than one block group. Crashes the source stores without a location are not returned by a map query, so their share is unknown here.
